verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents `humanlayer automation run` for running a Cloud-visible coding session from CI jobs, cron machines, or scripts, and describes non-interactive launch tokens for shells without a PTY, directly matching the headless CI/CD/shell-script use case. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of automation runs actually working in a real CI pipeline, and more detail on exit codes/output handling for scripting integration.
